patch.description: Latest verified tally remains 56 accepted / 90 held across 73 configurations / 146 faces. The candidate is diagnostic only and is rejected; no source geometry changed. S428 confirms the approved single body-neckline base seam and zero duplicate stand-base strokes in all 28 exact Woven output rows; 28 front collar contacts and 28 back sleeve-hem crossings remain held. The maintainer confirms preserving all holds, rejecting the unsupported Polo cap change and retaining the implemented segmented H. S432 applies the approved endpoint-residual exception only to the exact validated Polo S351 Sleeve-cap ease representation; 0.25 cm remains for every other relation. S433 fixes the 17-option Polo back colorway closure with a fill-only duplicate of the exact same-revision armhole seam; all 17 colorway renders pass. The two front POM label placements still fail in all 17 options; the exact J/FG keyed schedule trial awaits approval. All 56 Woven and 34 Polo faces remain held. Preserve all-seven V02, V02-before-V03, legacy DXF, protected exports and V03 rights/round-trip gates.
